subject: Per-charge entity tagging & VAT flow instructions for AeroTech pilot
messages:
From: Andrew Klein <andrew.klein@aerotech.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>; marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: finance <finance@aerotech.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Clarification on billing routing & VAT for pilot

Hi Priyom / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the pilot looks promising. Before we lock the PO, finance needs clarity on how Redwood will invoice multiple AeroTech legal entities for the same usage:

- We will be collecting charges for two subsidiaries (AeroTech EU AB and AeroTech Global Ltd). Can Redwood issue a single consolidated document with per-line entity tags, or do you produce separate invoices per legal entity?
- VAT: AeroTech EU AB is VAT-registered. For EU consumption, we need VAT to be shown on invoice lines tied to that entity.
- We expect two ledger IDs in our accounting system (GL-7001 for EU, GL-7002 for Global). Can you put ledger IDs on line items?

I've attached our internal mapping sheet (sample) and the draft PO (sample_po.pdf). Our target is to start pilot billing the week of Nov 22.

Short answers here are fine; if needed we can schedule a 30-min call.

Cheers,
Andrew
Andrew Klein
Head of Finance, AeroTech Inc.
andrew.klein@aerotech.com
+44 20 7946 1234

Attachments: sample_po.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
To: Andrew Klein <andrew.klein@aerotech.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>; lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-13T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on billing routing & VAT for pilot

Hi Andrew — thanks for the clear list. Short answers below and a proposed implementation attached.

- Per-line tagging: Yes — Redwood can emit a single invoice PDF with discrete invoice lines tagged by "bill_to_entity" metadata. We can also include a supplementary CSV export that lists each line with the ledger ID.
- Separate invoices: If AeroTech prefers separate legal invoices (one per VAT-entity), we can create two invoices each referencing the shared usage but billed to distinct legal entities. That will create two invoice documents rather than one consolidated PDF.
- VAT handling: For lines tagged to AeroTech EU AB we will: 1) include your VAT number on the invoice, 2) show VAT amounts computed per EU VAT rules, and 3) include a tax breakdown summary. For non-EU/Global entity lines we will leave VAT at 0% or show reverse-charge depending on the jurisdiction you confirm.
- Ledger IDs: We can insert GL-7001 / GL-7002 as a line-level attribute in the invoice metadata and in the CSV export.

Attached: redwood_proposed_split.pdf (example invoice layout + sample CSV columns) and AeroTech_MAAP_v1.xlsx (I mapped your PO sample to our line attributes).

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm whether you want a single consolidated invoice with per-line entity tags or two separate legal invoices.
2) Send the VAT registration number for AeroTech EU AB (we need it on the invoice).
3) Confirm the GL mapping for any charge types that should default to a specific ledger.

If it's easier, I'm happy to run a 20-min billing handoff with your team on Monday (Nov 16).

Thanks,

--
Priyom Das
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.inference

Attachments: redwood_proposed_split.pdf; AeroTech_MAAP_v1.xlsx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>

Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on billing routing & VAT for pilot

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 11:22 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference> wrote:
> - Per-line tagging: Yes — Redwood can emit a single invoice PDF with discrete invoice lines tagged by "bill_to_entity" metadata.

Andrew — adding a few operational details from the billing team so your finance team can reconcile easily: 

1) Invoice documents and exports
   - Option A (recommended for quick reconciliation): One PDF invoice that contains a header section per legal entity (when applicable) and a detailed line table that shows the GL mapping column. We also produce an attached CSV that your AR system can ingest.
   - Option B (strict legal separation): Two separate invoice numbers (INV-AT-XXXX for EU, INV-AT-YYYY for Global). This is required if your auditors require distinct documents per VAT entity.

2) VAT treatment
   - We require the EU VAT number for AeroTech EU AB prior to the first billed cycle. Once we have it we will validate it and populate the VAT fields. If reverse charge applies, we will reflect that in the tax summary per EU guidance.

3) Implementation notes
   - Line-level ledger tags (GL-7001/GL-7002) will be added to our billing export; they will not show as free-text on the PDF line but will be present in the CSV. If you want the GL id printed on the PDF line, confirm and we'll enable that.
   - For subscription/commit charges we will split the period pro rata across entities based on the MAAP mapping you returned. Usage-based charges are split per event.

4) Testing and fallback
   - We will run two test invoices for Nov billing (non-financial test XML/CSV and a sample PDF). After your confirmation we push live for the first pilot invoice.

Action items for AeroTech:
- Send VAT number for AeroTech EU AB (mandatory)
- Confirm Option A (consolidated PDF + CSV) or Option B (two legal invoices)
- Confirm whether GLs should be printed on the PDF or only in the CSV export

If you prefer, Ben and I can join the Nov 16 call Priyom suggested and walk through the sample invoice.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.inference

> Attachment: sample_invoice_layout.png (see redwood_proposed_split.pdf for full)

Thanks — that all looks good. Quick answers:

- We choose Option A (consolidated PDF + CSV). Our AP team prefers a single document to start; if auditors require separate legal invoices later we will request that.
- VAT: AeroTech EU AB VAT number is EU123456789. Please validate and include on the invoice lines for EU-tagged charges.
- GL on PDF: please include the GL id as a small printed column on the PDF line (helps our AP scanner).

I've attached the signed PO (PO-AT-2026-089) for the pilot. Let's run the non-financial test invoice on Nov 22 and then go live for billing on the next cycle.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Priyom — can you confirm the test invoice timestamp and who will send the CSV?

Regards,
